name: global-news-digest
description: Global news digest from 6+ regions with comprehensive sources and parallel fetching

steps.name: init-date
steps.prompt: Get today's date in a human-readable format. Return only the date string.

steps.name: fetch-north-america
steps.prompt:
Fetch North American news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL - start all requests simultaneously.

Sources:
🇺🇸 USA:
- Associated Press: https://feeds.ap.org/apnews/top25
- NPR: https://feeds.npr.org/1001/rss.xml
- Reuters US: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/us

🇨🇦 Canada:
- CBC: https://www.cbc.ca/cmlink/rss-topstories
- Global News: https://globalnews.ca/feed/

🇲🇽 Mexico:
- Mexico News Daily: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/feed/

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously (parallel, not sequential). Don't wait for one to finish before starting the next.

For each working feed: Extract top 5 recent articles with headline, summary, country. If a feed takes >15s or fails, skip it and continue.

Return structured list grouped by country.

steps.name: collect-and-summarize
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Global News Digest from all gathered sources.

Date: {{today_date}}

NORTH AMERICA:
{{na_news}}

EUROPE:
{{eu_news}}

ASIA-PACIFIC:
{{ap_news}}

MIDDLE EAST & AFRICA:
{{mea_news}}

SOUTH AMERICA:
{{sa_news}}

SCANDINAVIA:
{{scandi_news}}

TASK:
1. Review all articles (you should have many sources across 6 regions)
2. Select the 15-20 most significant global stories
3. Group by category: World Affairs, Politics, Business/Economy, Tech/Science, Culture/Society
4. Write concise 1-2 sentence summaries
5. Note source country for context
6. Keep under 2000 characters

FORMAT:
```
🌍 **Global News Digest — {{today_date}}**

**🌐 World Affairs**
• [Headline] — Summary (🇺🇸/🇬🇧/🇩🇪/etc)
• [Headline] — Summary (Source country flag)
• [Headline] — Summary

**💼 Business & Economy**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🔬 Tech & Science**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source)

**🎭 Culture & Society**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source)

_Covering 6 regions, 20+ countries, 100+ sources — OpenFang Global News_
```

Include country flags (🇺🇸🇬🇧🇩🇪🇫🇷🇯🇵🇨🇳🇮🇳🇦🇺🇸🇦🇿🇦🇧🇷🇳🇴🇸🇪🇫🇮🇩🇰🇮🇸) where relevant.
